description.value: The Derby Restaurant is a licensed dining room located on the second floor of the Cedar Hill Golf Course Clubhouse, operated by Lakeland Golf Management on behalf of the District of Saanich. The menu leans toward casual favourites including house-ground burgers, seafood chowder, and fresh fish tacos, alongside starters and desserts. A separate Derby Express counter offers a faster service option, and the clubhouse is fully accessible via elevator with accessible washrooms on site.
